description.value: The study compared global cerebral and cerebellar intensity normalization methods for detecting and differentiating early Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal lobar degeneration using voxelwise FDG-PET.

spans.text: As most studies use either intensity normalization to the CMRglc (mean metabolic rate for glucose in the whole brain) or to cerebellar glucose consumption, we compared these two methods with respect to their superiority in both detecting dementia and also in differentiating between different types of dementia.
